name: coupang
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE completely independent finished Korean Threads shopping card, exact target 1080 x 1350 pixels, portrait aspect ratio 4:5. The attached 3-panel image is a STYLE/CONTENT REFERENCE ONLY. Redraw and compose a brand-new SINGLE card from scratch. NEVER produce a collage, contact sheet, multiple panels, surrounding frame, or a cropped/enlarged panel from the reference. Use the cute vivid glossy golden retriever and tricolor calico cat character style shown, thick smooth rounded Korean typography, excellent Korean spelling, mobile readability, white rounded product rows, warm cream unit-price pills, red prominent prices. High quality commercial character illustration and clean editorial typography. Five rows, every number aligned correctly to its corresponding product. No inaccurate price claims, no invented timestamps, no 'confirmed today' claims. Design example based on supplied old reference, NOT a current verified sale listing.
Composition on 1080x1350: safe 32px side margins. Top affiliate disclosure 2 short readable lines in a soft tinted pill y24..110; brand row at y130: red rounded square white '딜', black '핫딜픽', platform word badge. Header y200..355: '오늘의 장바구니' in huge rounded bold text with yellow underline on left, character illustration upper right. Date line '디자인 참고 시안 · 2026.10.31 자료'. Five clean white rounded product rows stacked between y405 and y1200, row height about 145 with 14px gaps. Each row: numbered circle 01 to 05, product photo-style illustration at left, two short lines of Korean product name center, large red won price at right, pale cream unit pill below. Use only the requested platform's five products. Bottom y1240: rounded saturated color button 'hotdealpick.kr' and arrow, text '결제 전 최종가 확인'. Last line at y1320 small but readable: '예시 상품·가격 · 게시 전 실제 판매정보로 교체'. Avoid seasonal Halloween decoration in background so the STYLE remains reusable all year. Keep artwork polished, playful, consistent, and uncluttered.
PLATFORM: 쿠팡. Peach/ivory background, red #F43132 accents, deep red title. Main characters: friendly golden retriever and small calico cat leaning from one red shopping basket, round red '딜' tag on basket. Little hearts. Match left reference personality. Top disclosure verbatim: '이 포스팅은 쿠팡 파트너스 활동의 일환으로, 이에 따른 일정액의 수수료를 제공받습니다.'

02 '엘투 할로윈 츄이 캔디' / '약 100봉지 · 400g', price '16,550원', unit '10g당 414원'. Blue and dark orange chewy candy pouches.
03 '호박바구니 파티용품' / '소 · 혼합색상 36개', price '14,490원', unit '1개당 403원'. Cluster of tiny orange jack-o-lantern buckets.
04 '파티해 LED 20구' / '큐티 가랜드 호박', price '5,450원', unit '1세트 5,450원'. Orange pumpkin string lights on a dark mini photo.
05 '파티쇼 콘서트 야광팔찌' / '5mm · 100개 (랜덤 색)', price '9,010원', unit '1개당 90원'. Multicolor thin neon glow bracelets.
